original_contract.name: NSE_A_PHYSICAL_H1_FOURIER_SIX_PROJECTORS
original_contract.exact_completion: Construct the complete native real compact-test H1 carrier and Schwartz admission; prove the two-way first-derivative Fourier bridge with no added H2 premise; construct the fixed six even Borel-sector projections and prove reality, orthogonality, reconstruction, derivative and solenoidal commutation, and physical gradient-charge additivity.

clauses.clause: Complete native real compact-test H1 carrier, including its solenoidal restriction.
clauses.assessment: Closed kernels of actual compact-test pairing maps define the real full-volume weak-gradient graph. The norm includes velocity and all three L2 weak derivatives; completeness and native Solenoidal restriction are constructed.

clauses.clause: Schwartz admission into that same native carrier.
clauses.assessment: Actual classical Schwartz derivatives are proved to satisfy the compact-test weak derivative relation, and native solenoidal Schwartz input is inserted into the complete physical H1_sigma graph with unchanged velocity.

clauses.clause: Two-way first-derivative Fourier bridge with no added H2 premise.
clauses.assessment: The equivalence is between an actual supplied L2 first derivative and its a.e. 2*pi*i*xi_j multiplier. The signature contains no Laplacian or second-derivative witness. This is exactly the original P02 requirement; a separate weighted-membership-to-H1 construction is not required by G05.

clauses.clause: Fixed six even Borel-sector construction, including ties and zero frequency.
clauses.assessment: The actual registered sorted absolute-coordinate rule partitions all frequencies with the stated tie handling; evenness is proved for each fixed sector.

clauses.clause: Actual L2 projection construction and real preservation.
clauses.assessment: Discontinuous indicators act on actual L2 representatives. The real/Hermitian Fourier-range bridge is proved by actual Fourier transport and density. Real part constructs the real output and exact complexification identifies it with the intended complex sector projection.

clauses.clause: Boundedness, orthogonality and reconstruction on the actual carrier.
clauses.assessment: The constructed real L2, full physical H1 and original solenoidal physical H1 operators have the required projection algebra, orthogonality, norm bound and exact finite reconstruction.

clauses.clause: Actual weak-derivative commutation and H1 invariance.
clauses.assessment: Projection of the already supplied physical L2 first derivatives is proved to be the actual weak gradient of the projected velocity. No Schwartz preservation, H2 assumption or sharp-indicator multiplication on general distributions is used.

The original compact-test Solenoidal predicate, including test-pairing integrability, is equivalent to zero actual L2 divergence trace. Coordinate naturality is proved and transfers that zero trace. The Sigma output is then constructed in the original closed graph; preservation is a conclusion, not a supplied interface.

clauses.clause: Same-field physical gradient charges and exact additivity.
clauses.assessment: Each charge is the sum of the squared actual projected gradient-component L2 norms; it is already a squared Frobenius gradient norm. Those unique gradients belong to the same projected velocity. Summing the six charges gives the actual total physical enstrophy.

clauses.clause: Original P06 exact 4*pi^2 cone-restricted Fourier identity.
clauses.assessment: Genuine weighted integrability is derived using only actual first derivatives. The charge equals 4*pi^2 times the literal integral over the registered sector of |xi|^2 times the full vector Fourier norm squared. The coefficient and original solenoidal carrier are retained.
